log.speaker: Sam
log.text: I want to learn to handle a whole repair myself. I still have my own plans and promises.

log.speaker: Mum
log.text: I used this lantern on the walk home when you were small. It still has work left in it.

log.speaker: Sam
log.text: I have the morning free. If you want company, I’d like to see how you find the fault. I promised to help my sister later.

log.speaker: Workshop
log.text: Time waits for your decisions. Tests leave evidence. Parts and promises are finite.

log.speaker: Workshop
log.text: Recovered one working switch. The donor is now committed to salvage.

log.speaker: Mum
log.text: Mum’s walking lantern is back in use.

log.speaker: Workshop
log.text: Word of the family repair reaches the neighbours. Three requests are waiting. You do not have to accept all of them.

log.text: We can use the room and garden tomorrow. The site opens at noon; people arrive at 15:00. We have time to prepare two formats, at most. Your paper theatre could be one of them.
